target_customer: Car wash operators, from single sites to large chains, that sell monthly unlimited wash memberships
problem: Car washes moving to recurring memberships lacked software to sell, market and retain subscribers on top of their existing point of sale systems, so churn and missed upsells went unmanaged.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for car wash CRM, marketing automation and membership sales tools
product_category: Vertical SaaS, car wash CRM and membership management

founders.name: Austin Esecson
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no background; Series A press release says only that the team combines car wash expertise with technology experience.

founders.name: Nic Hippenmeyer
founders.background_notes: Title as listed on the YC page; no background found in opened sources.

founders.name: Sam Logan
founders.background_notes: No background found in opened sources.

competitors.name: DRB (Washify and car wash POS)
competitors.what: Car wash point of sale vendor moving to subscription licensing and offering recurring billing for unlimited plans
competitors.traction_then: Established vendor; no figures in the source

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly standard SaaS work: integrations with existing POS systems plus automated email and text campaigns and online checkout. The hard part was POS integration breadth, not research.

defensibility.rationale: Integration with each operator's POS and subscriber data creates some lock-in, but POS vendors could build similar CRM features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying Rinsed; the company raised Series A in 2022 and Series B in 2023 and stayed independent.

market_need_then: Pandemic era data cited by a DRB-sourced analysis said car wash sites without unlimited plans lost far more revenue in the first wave of shutdowns, which pushed operators toward memberships.

branding.domain_note: Company site is rinsed.com; one pricing page appears under rinsed.co. Acquisition history of the domain not found.

identity.mascot_or_character: Mo, a built-in AI assistant, appears in later product marketing
identity.voice_and_tone: Short, direct, confident, outcome focused with imperative headlines

branding.community_and_virality: No evidence of merch or fan community found; trade press coverage is mainly press releases in car wash industry outlets.

brand_strength.rationale: A clear, memorable word that fits the car wash category and tagline 'The Car Wash CRM', but little evidence of brand driven growth beyond category fit.

outcome_analysis: Rinsed rode the shift of car washes to monthly memberships with a CRM that sits on top of existing POS systems. It reported ARR growth above 400 percent in the year before its 2022 Series A, raised a Series B in 2023, and bought Ignite Wash in May 2024 to add a sales platform. It is active with a reported 3,000 plus locations as customers.
notes: Seed amount of about 3 million comes from the Series A press release (co-led by Bedrock with Y Combinator), seed date not stated. Aggregators total 32 to 35 million raised and disagree. Founder backgrounds not found in opened sources. The only dated competitor source is a July 2021 DRB blog, a few months after the batch; competitor lists on CB Insights and similar sites are undated and not used. Acquired Ignite Wash in May 2024 (company press release).
